vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: golden-master
Version: 1.0.4

The 'Golden Master' skill is a documentation management tool designed to track source-of-truth relationships between files using SHA256 checksums. It operates by analyzing file content overlap and generating metadata comments for staleness tracking within a local repository. The instructions in SKILL.md explicitly restrict the agent from auto-modifying files without consent, forbid external API calls, and include a specific warning against using shell commands for checksum calculation, favoring programmatic implementation instead.
